notes.subject: ומעליו
notes.rationale: 'long ol samting i antap long em' — KJV 'from himself', YLT 'from his fruits'; Min tingting ol samting i stap antap (God i givim) i stret

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Objek bilong fulim — Hibru i no putim, Tok Pisin i nidim

notes.subject: ומעליו
notes.rationale: Sapos i tok 'long olgeta we i winim em' — man gutpela i kisim fulap bikos ol i winim em

translation: Man bilong bel i save go bek, ol rot bilong em yet i fulim em; tasol man gutpela, ol samting bilong em i antap long em i fulim ⟨em⟩.

tokens.gloss: ol samting i antap long em
